name: mgu-styles
description: MGU Styles - Toro (Lamborghini) and M (BMW M View) instrument clusters for BMW iDrive 7 (MGU)

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js && node tools/stage-app.js --check && npm run compile-check
scripts.compile-check: node tools/shot.js build/compile-check.png "t=5&freeze=1" && node tools/shot.js build/compile-track.png "t=5&freeze=1&style=track&show=map" && node tools/shot.js build/compile-turn.png "t=5&freeze=1&style=track&turn=uturn" && node tools/shot.js build/compile-extras.png "t=5&freeze=1&holiday=on&intro=on&since=3&shiftStyle=gt3" && node tools/shot.js build/compile-blade.png "t=5&freeze=1&shiftStyle=blade&rpm=7000" && node tools/shot.js build/compile-m.png "fixture=m&freeze=1&strip=off" && node tools/shot.js build/compile-m-drive.png "t=6&freeze=1&style=track&mPanel=mode&drive=ADAPTIVE&holiday=on&clock12=on"
